name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task commands 'Open the door, then take the box', but no clause makes target_picked_up happen. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) alone requires nothing, and the machine's FINAL_STATES (u3) can be reached merely by opening the door. Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up); the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) then also forces door_open, so the standalone hard Existence(door_open) is redundant and should be removed. Keep Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open) and the soft Absence(key_lost) (correctly soft per 'try not to', and key_lost is an event, so plain Absence matches the wording).

texts: Open the door, then take the box.
Take the box from the other room.
Do not open the door before the blocker is moved.
Try not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
